hooks.name: test-buddy
hooks.description: When a new component file is created under a src/components folder, create its Vitest + vitest-axe test.

action.prompt: A new component file was just created in a src/components folder. Create its test at tests/unit/<ComponentName>.test.tsx in the same project (the folder that contains src/). First read two existing tests in that tests/unit folder and follow their pattern, setup and imports. If a test file for this component already exists, do not overwrite it; say so and stop. The test must render the component with any providers it needs, assert that vitest-axe reports zero violations, and, if the component is interactive, test its keyboard behaviour (Tab, Enter, Space, Escape or arrow keys as its pattern requires). Then run the new test with 'npx vitest run tests/unit/<ComponentName>.test.tsx' from the project folder and fix it until it passes. If axe reports a violation, fix the component, not the test. Never weaken the assertion or disable an axe rule. Finish with one line: the test file path and its pass or fail result.
